contexts: Many neural rendering techniques employ \textit{neural fields} as the underlying 3D representation -- coordinate neural networks that can represent a variety of signals including images~\cite{martel2021acorn, sitzmann2019siren}, surface manifolds~\cite{park2019deepsdf, wang2021neus, volsdf}, and volumetric densities~\cite{mildenhall2020nerf}.
